leadText: Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White (Japanese: ポケモンBW 爆笑4コマまんが全集 Pokémon Black & White Laughter 4Koma Comic Compilation) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by Santa Harukaze. Released by VIZ Media in October 2013, Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White was the first Pokémon 4Koma manga to be officially translated into English by any company.
plainText:
Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White (Japanese: ポケモンBW 爆笑4コマまんが全集 Pokémon Black & White Laughter 4Koma Comic Compilation) is a Pokémon 4Koma created by Santa Harukaze. Released by VIZ Media in October 2013, Pokémon Pocket Comics: Black & White was the first Pokémon 4Koma manga to be officially translated into English by any company.

==Publications==
 
 
 

==Content==
Each comic in the series represents a Pokémon from the Unova Pokédex, illustrating an attribute or special ability of each Pokémon using a humorous cartoon ( , and are excluded). The series primarily uses as a source of humour. All the Pokémon are depicted as being able to talk, and no human characters appear in the series.

In addition to the manga pages, the volume also includes a type chart, Pokémon trivia quizzes next to each comic, and listings such as "Top 3 Heaviest Pokémon", "Top 3 Smallest Pokémon", etc.

==Trivia==
This manga was revealed to North American audiences for the first time on 2013, in which a sampler of this manga was included with Comics, which is also published by VIZ Media.
